title: ABC Suspends 'Jimmy Kimmel Live!' Over Charlie Kirk Comments
transcript: This morning, Jimmy Kimmel off the air.
shows: Aerial night shot of the Jimmy Kimmel Live marquee/logo over the Hollywood strip; TODAY lower-third 'ABC Pulls Jimmy Kimmel Off Air'; small on-screen source credit '"Jimmy Kimmel Live!"/ABC' top right.

title: ABC Suspends 'Jimmy Kimmel Live!' Over Charlie Kirk Comments
shows: Muted paparazzi-style b-roll (credited 'TNLA') of a man in a cap and a blonde woman getting into a black SUV in a parking garage, described by TODAY as Kimmel leaving his studio the night of the suspension; TODAY lower-third persists.

title: FCC chair on Jimmy Kimmel's Charlie Kirk comments: 'Sickest conduct possible'
transcript: appears to be some of the sickest conduct possible.
shows: FCC Chairman Brendan Carr's audio over an AP file photo of Jimmy Kimmel in a tuxedo at a red-carpet backdrop with ABC and Kimmel-show logos; 'THE ASSOCIATED PRESS' watermark top left.

title: ABC Suspends 'Jimmy Kimmel Live!' Over Charlie Kirk Comments
transcript: And on Truth Social, President Trump congratulating ABC for, quote, finally having the courage to do what had to be done.
shows: TODAY anchor voice-over Jimmy Kimmel Live's animated skyline logo while the anchor reads Trump's Truth Social post aloud; TODAY lower-third persists.

title: President Trump on Jimmy Kimmel: "He was fired for lack of talent."
shows: Muted wide/press-pool shot of the crowded press room at the UK joint news conference, a reporter holding a GB News microphone mid-question; C-SPAN banner 'Trump & British Prime Minister Keir Starmer Hold Joint News Conference'.

title: President Trump on Jimmy Kimmel: "He was fired for lack of talent."
transcript: You can call that free speech or not. He was fired for lack of talent.
shows: Trump at the podium at the UK joint press conference with Keir Starmer, US/UK flags behind him; C-SPAN banner 'Trump & British Prime Minister Keir Starmer Hold Joint News Conference'.
